Name: FarmhandFinder
Author: 2Retr0
Description:
[size=5][b][size=6]FarmhandFinder[/size][/b]
Description
[/size]Ever needed to give someone an item only to end up aimlessly running around in an attempt to locate them? This mod attempts to solve
this mild annoyance by adding a compass pointing to players in the same location as you (while hopefully not being another annoyance?).
As an introduction...

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6ONgpJg.gif[/img]﻿[b]Here is an example of how the compass would appear in game![/b] [i](Unlike this demo, however, it will appear at the edge of the screen)[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/njqj4DF.gif[/img][b]The compass also dynamically changes per player to reflect their current appearance![/b] [i](Hats included for fun!)[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vL72cl7.gif[/img]﻿[b]Additionally, the compass hides when colliding with a UI element![/b] [i](In an effort to reduce obtrusiveness﻿—hopefully.)[/i]


[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5 on Windows. (Untested on Linux/Mac but should work fine!)
[/list][list]
[*]Works [i]only[/i] on multiplayer.
[/list]
